specAcceptance.reason: V6-02 establishes test infrastructure; it implements no authenticated API resource access, so cross-tenant 404 behavior is not exercised here.
CSRF rejection is runtime API behavior; V6-02 adds no write endpoint and no session middleware.
The database session tenant setting is database-layer behavior; V6-02 adds no database access.
S13 maps case-scope deletion re-authentication to V6-49; V6-02 implements no deletion endpoint.
S13 maps review-link and export-download failure after deletion to V6-49.
S13 maps backup restore and tombstone enforcement to V6-49.
S13 maps privacy export projection to V6-43a, built on V6-49.
S13 maps last-owner user-scope deletion refusal to V6-43a, built on V6-49.
Log and error-response redaction is runtime logging behavior; V6-02 emits no application log or error response that carries matter content.
Unconfigured identity provider handling belongs to the G-AUTH login path; V6-02 has no login surface.

limitations: Coordinator integration: the root package.json test:v6 script was added by the orchestrator, which owns root manifest edits per 06-execution-protocol. Pre-existing unrelated package.json/package-lock.json modifications were left untouched.
Dual-tenant fixture validates fixture ownership routing only; product API/RLS behavior is not implemented by this ticket.
All-skipped, missing-command, missing-dependency and zero-test probes use OS temporary directories or an injected spawn result; no repository paths are created or mutated by the probes.
negative-checks.txt is a transcript of one probe run; the TAP duration_ms lines vary between runs, while exit codes and messages do not.
Node treats a test file that declares no tests as one passing file, so the total=0 branch is exercised through the verdict parser probe instead of an on-disk empty suite.
No V6-02 test opens a network connection, database session or model call.
V6-02 remains candidate until independent review; no commit, deployment or real-data operation was performed.
Preservation check: all 407 paths in qa/v6/baseline/untracked-sha256.txt still match and the 39 tracked paths are unchanged; no commit was made.
